metadata.course: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics
metadata.attribution: Original scope and sequence authored for the Luminfest Learning Harness, dedicated to the public domain under CC0.
metadata.scope: Structure only: concept titles, unit order and prerequisite intent. No third-party curriculum text is reproduced, and no restricted source is ingested.
metadata.description: An introductory algebra-based physics course: measurement and modelling, mechanics, waves and optics, electricity and magnetism, thermodynamics, and modern physics.

units: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension

concepts.title: Acceleration
concepts.unit: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension
concepts.summary: Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, so an object turns even at constant speed when its direction changes.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Amplitude and energy in waves
concepts.summary: A wave's energy depends on the square of its amplitude, so doubling amplitude quadruples the energy carried.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Angular momentum
concepts.summary: In the absence of external torque angular momentum is conserved, so a spinning body speeds up as it pulls its mass inward.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Angular quantities
concepts.summary: Angular position, velocity and acceleration mirror their linear counterparts with angle in place of distance.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Atomic energy levels and spectra
concepts.summary: Atoms absorb and emit only specific photon energies, which is why line spectra are a fingerprint.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Atomic structure and the nucleus
concepts.summary: Protons and neutrons make up a nucleus whose size is set by the strong force, not by electron orbits.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Beats
concepts.summary: Two close frequencies produce a slow loudness pulse at the difference frequency.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Centre of mass
concepts.summary: A system moves as though all its mass sat at the centre of mass and all external forces acted there.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Centripetal acceleration and force
concepts.summary: The net force in circular motion points toward the centre, and something real must supply it.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Conservation of mechanical energy
concepts.summary: When only conservative forces act, the total of kinetic and potential energy stays fixed.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Conservation of momentum
concepts.summary: In the absence of external forces the total momentum of a system does not change, even during a collision.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Constructive and destructive interference
concepts.summary: Path difference in whole wavelengths reinforces and half wavelengths cancels.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Coulomb's law
concepts.summary: The force between two point charges follows an inverse-square law and is attractive or repulsive by sign.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Damping and resonance
concepts.summary: Damping removes energy and lowers the amplitude, while driving at the natural frequency makes it grow.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Diffraction and the double slit
concepts.summary: Waves spread around obstacles, and two slits produce a pattern of bright and dark fringes from path difference.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Diffraction gratings
concepts.summary: Many slits sharpen the maxima, which is what makes a grating a precision wavelength-measuring device.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Dimensional analysis
concepts.summary: Checking that both sides of an equation carry the same dimensions catches most algebra errors before any numbers are substituted.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Dispersion and colour
concepts.summary: A refractive index that varies with wavelength separates white light into its components.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Efficiency
concepts.summary: Efficiency is useful output over total input and is always below one for a real machine.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Elastic and inelastic collisions
concepts.summary: Momentum is conserved in both kinds of collision, but kinetic energy only in the elastic ones.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Elastic potential energy
concepts.summary: A stretched spring stores energy proportional to the square of its extension.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Electric charge and conservation
concepts.summary: Charge comes in two kinds, is quantised in units of the electron charge, and is conserved in every interaction.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Electric current and charge flow
concepts.summary: Current is the rate of charge flow, and conventional current runs opposite to electron drift.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Electric field and field lines
concepts.summary: An electric field gives the force per unit positive charge, and field lines never cross.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Electric potential and potential difference
concepts.summary: Potential is energy per unit charge, and only differences in it are physically meaningful.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Electrical power and energy transfer
concepts.summary: Power dissipated in a component is current times voltage, which is why high-voltage transmission wastes less.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Electromagnetic waves
concepts.summary: An accelerating charge radiates self-sustaining electric and magnetic fields that travel at the speed of light.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Electromotive force and internal resistance
concepts.summary: A real source has internal resistance, so the terminal voltage falls as the current drawn rises.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Energy in simple harmonic motion
concepts.summary: Energy trades continuously between kinetic and potential while the total stays fixed in an ideal oscillator.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Energy stored in a capacitor
concepts.summary: A capacitor stores energy proportional to the square of the voltage across it.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Escape velocity
concepts.summary: Escape velocity is the speed at which an object's kinetic energy just pays for climbing out of a gravity well.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Faraday's law of induction
concepts.summary: A changing flux induces an emf, and the faster the change the larger the emf.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Fission, fusion and energy release
concepts.summary: Both fission and fusion release energy because the products are more tightly bound than the reactants.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Force on a current-carrying conductor
concepts.summary: A current in a field feels a force, which is how an electric motor produces torque.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Force on a moving charge
concepts.summary: A charge moving in a magnetic field feels a force perpendicular to both its velocity and the field.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Forces as interactions
concepts.summary: A force is one object acting on another; every force has an agent and a recipient.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Free-body diagrams
concepts.summary: Drawing every force on a single object, with no forces belonging to other objects, is the step most errors skip.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Free fall
concepts.unit: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension
concepts.summary: Near the surface of the Earth all objects fall with the same downward acceleration when air resistance is negligible.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Friction
concepts.summary: Static friction matches the applied force up to a maximum; kinetic friction opposes sliding at a roughly fixed value.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Graphing and linearising relationships
concepts.summary: Plotting the right combination of variables turns a power law into a straight line whose slope carries the constant.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Gravitational field and field strength
concepts.summary: A field describes the force per unit mass a test object would feel at a point in space.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Gravitational potential energy
concepts.summary: Near the Earth's surface gravitational potential energy depends only on height change, not on the path taken.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Gravitational potential energy in a field
concepts.summary: Far from a planet the simple mgh formula fails and potential energy must be measured from infinity.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Half-life and decay rates
concepts.summary: Half-life is the time for half of any sample to decay, so activity falls exponentially.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Heat engines and efficiency
concepts.summary: No engine converting heat to work can exceed the Carnot limit set by the two reservoir temperatures.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Heat transfer by conduction, convection and radiation
concepts.summary: The three mechanisms differ in whether they need a medium and in whether they carry matter.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Impulse and momentum change
concepts.summary: A given change in momentum can come from a large force briefly or a small force for longer, which is what safety features exploit.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Inclined planes
concepts.summary: Resolving weight into components along and perpendicular to a slope turns a two-dimensional problem into two one-dimensional ones.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Intensity, loudness and the decibel scale
concepts.summary: The decibel scale is logarithmic because human loudness perception is roughly logarithmic too.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Internal energy and thermal equilibrium
concepts.summary: Heat flows spontaneously from hotter to colder until temperatures equalise and net flow stops.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Isotopes and nuclear stability
concepts.summary: Isotopes of an element differ only in neutron number, and the neutron-to-proton ratio decides stability.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Kinematic equations for constant acceleration
concepts.unit: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension
concepts.summary: The four kinematic equations are the same relationship rearranged, each omitting a different variable.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Kinetic energy
concepts.summary: Kinetic energy grows with the square of speed, which is why stopping distance grows so quickly.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Kinetic theory of gases
concepts.summary: Gas pressure comes from countless particle collisions, which explains the gas laws from mechanics.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Kirchhoff's circuit laws
concepts.summary: Charge conservation at a junction and energy conservation around a loop give two rules that solve any network.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Latent heat and changes of state
concepts.summary: During a phase change energy goes into breaking bonds, so temperature stays constant.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Lenses and image formation
concepts.summary: A thin lens forms a real or virtual image whose position follows from the object distance and focal length.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Lenz's law
concepts.summary: An induced current opposes the change that produced it, which is energy conservation in disguise.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Linear momentum
concepts.summary: Momentum is mass times velocity, and it is a vector because velocity is.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Magnetic field of a current
concepts.summary: A current produces a circular magnetic field around it, unifying electricity and magnetism.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Magnetic fields and poles
concepts.summary: Magnetic field lines run from north to south outside a magnet and form closed loops.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Magnetic flux
concepts.summary: Flux measures how much field passes through a surface, so angle and area both matter.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Mass and weight
concepts.summary: Mass measures inertia; weight is the gravitational force on that mass and changes with location.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Mass-energy equivalence
concepts.summary: Mass and energy are interconvertible, and the mass defect of a nucleus appears as binding energy.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Measurement uncertainty and error
concepts.summary: Random and systematic errors behave differently, and only one of them improves by averaging.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Moment of inertia and rotational dynamics
concepts.summary: How mass is distributed about the axis matters as much as how much mass there is.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Motion graphs
concepts.unit: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension
concepts.summary: The slope of a position-time graph is velocity and the slope of a velocity-time graph is acceleration.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Newton's first law and inertia
concepts.summary: An object's velocity changes only when the net force is nonzero, which is why motion needs no cause but change does.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Newton's law of universal gravitation
concepts.summary: Every mass attracts every other mass with a force proportional to both masses and falling off as the square of the distance.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Newton's second law
concepts.summary: Net force equals mass times acceleration, so the same force accelerates a larger mass less.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Newton's third law and interaction pairs
concepts.summary: Forces come in equal and opposite pairs acting on two different objects, which is why they never cancel on one body.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Normal force
concepts.summary: The normal force is a contact push perpendicular to a surface and adjusts to whatever the situation requires.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Orbital motion and Kepler's laws
concepts.summary: An orbit is continuous free fall, and Kepler's laws follow from the inverse-square force.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Order-of-magnitude estimation
concepts.summary: A rough estimate that is right to a factor of ten is often enough to reject a wrong answer.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Period and frequency of a spring-mass system
concepts.summary: A stiffer spring oscillates faster and a heavier mass oscillates slower, and neither changes the amplitude.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Physical quantities and SI units
concepts.summary: Every physical quantity is a number together with a unit, and the unit is what makes the number meaningful.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Position, displacement and distance
concepts.unit: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension
concepts.summary: Displacement is a vector change in position; distance is the scalar path length and they differ whenever the path bends.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Potential dividers and sensing circuits
concepts.summary: Two resistors in series split a supply voltage in proportion to their resistance, which is the basis of many sensors.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Power
concepts.summary: Power is the rate of energy transfer, so the same work done faster requires more power.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Radioactive decay
concepts.summary: Alpha, beta and gamma decay each change the nucleus differently and have different penetrating power.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Reflection and plane mirrors
concepts.summary: The angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence, measured from the normal.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Refraction and Snell's law
concepts.summary: Light bends when its speed changes between media, and the bending follows the ratio of the speeds.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Relative motion in one dimension
concepts.unit: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension
concepts.summary: Velocities add as vectors, so a description of motion depends on the frame it is measured in.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Resistance and Ohm's law
concepts.summary: For an ohmic conductor current is proportional to voltage, and the constant of proportionality is the resistance.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Resistivity and temperature
concepts.summary: Resistance depends on material, length and cross-section, and for metals it rises with temperature.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Resonance in pipes and strings
concepts.summary: Boundary conditions fix which standing waves fit, which is why instruments have characteristic harmonic series.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Restoring force and oscillation
concepts.summary: An oscillation needs a restoring force that always points back toward equilibrium.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Scalars and vectors
concepts.unit: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension
concepts.summary: A scalar has magnitude only; a vector has magnitude and direction, and direction is what makes it a different kind of object.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Series and parallel circuits
concepts.summary: Series elements share the current and parallel elements share the voltage, which is why household wiring is parallel.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Significant figures and precision
concepts.summary: A measurement's written precision should reflect the instrument, not the display of the calculator.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Simple harmonic motion
concepts.summary: When the restoring force is proportional to displacement the motion is sinusoidal and its period is independent of amplitude.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Sound as a pressure wave
concepts.summary: Sound is a longitudinal compression wave that needs a medium, which is why it cannot cross a vacuum.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Specific heat capacity
concepts.summary: The energy needed to raise a temperature depends on the material's specific heat capacity as well as the mass.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Speed and velocity
concepts.unit: Vectors and kinematics in one dimension
concepts.summary: Velocity is the rate of change of displacement, so its sign carries direction while speed does not.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Speed of sound and the Doppler effect
concepts.summary: Relative motion between source and observer changes the observed frequency even though the source is unchanged.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Spring force and Hooke's law
concepts.summary: A spring's restoring force is proportional to its extension, so it pulls harder the further it is stretched.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Standing waves and nodes
concepts.summary: Two counter-propagating waves form fixed nodes and antinodes, and the allowed patterns are quantised by the boundary.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Temperature and the kinetic model
concepts.summary: Temperature measures the average random kinetic energy of particles, not the total energy stored.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Tension in strings and ropes
concepts.summary: In an ideal massless string the tension is the same everywhere, which is what makes pulley problems tractable.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The Bohr model and its limits
concepts.summary: Quantised orbits predict hydrogen's spectrum but fail for anything with more than one electron.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The electromagnetic spectrum
concepts.summary: Visible light is one narrow band of a continuous spectrum that all travels at the same speed in vacuum.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The first law of thermodynamics
concepts.summary: Energy added as heat either raises internal energy or does work, and never disappears.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The ideal gas law
concepts.summary: Pressure, volume and temperature of a dilute gas are linked by a single equation of state.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The photoelectric effect
concepts.summary: Electrons are emitted only above a threshold frequency, which wave theory cannot explain.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The photon model of light
concepts.summary: Light arrives in discrete packets whose energy depends only on frequency, which explains the photoelectric effect.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The principle of superposition
concepts.summary: Where waves overlap their displacements add, which is the whole basis of interference.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The second law and entropy
concepts.summary: Entropy of an isolated system never decreases, which is what gives time a direction in thermodynamics.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: The simple pendulum
concepts.summary: For small swings a pendulum's period depends only on its length and the local gravitational field.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Thermodynamic processes
concepts.summary: Isothermal, adiabatic, isobaric and isochoric processes each hold one variable fixed and give different work.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Torque and rotational equilibrium
concepts.summary: Torque depends on both the force and how far from the pivot it acts, which is why a long lever helps.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Total internal reflection
concepts.summary: Beyond the critical angle light cannot escape a dense medium, which is how optical fibres guide signals.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Transformers and power transmission
concepts.summary: A changing flux links two coils so voltage steps up or down while power is roughly preserved.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Transverse and longitudinal waves
concepts.summary: The distinction is whether the medium moves perpendicular to the wave's travel or along it.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Uniform circular motion
concepts.summary: Constant speed in a circle still means acceleration, because the direction of velocity keeps changing.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Uniform fields and capacitors
concepts.summary: Two parallel plates give a uniform field, and a capacitor stores charge proportional to the applied voltage.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Wave-particle duality
concepts.summary: Electrons diffract and light carries momentum, so neither model alone describes nature.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Wavefronts and rays
concepts.summary: Wavefronts and rays are two views of the same wave, useful for interference and for geometric optics respectively.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Wavelength, frequency and wave speed
concepts.summary: Wave speed is frequency times wavelength, and changing medium changes speed and wavelength but not frequency.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Work done by a force
concepts.summary: Work is force times displacement along the force, so a force perpendicular to motion does no work.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics

concepts.title: Work done by non-conservative forces
concepts.summary: Friction and drag convert mechanical energy into internal energy, so mechanical energy is not conserved when they act.

provenance.source: Physics — Mechanics, Waves, Electricity and Modern Physics
